title: Did Madoff's Victims Get Their Money Back?
hook: Did the victims get|their money back?

lines.say: Bernie Madoff's investors put in an estimated seventeen and a half billion dollars.
lines.show: Bernie Madoff's investors put in an estimated $17.5 billion.

lines.say: By twenty twenty-one, trustees had recovered more than fourteen billion.
lines.show: By 2021, trustees had recovered more than $14 billion.

lines.say: Separately, the Justice Department's Madoff Victim Fund paid out more than four point three billion dollars.
lines.show: Separately, the Justice Department's Madoff Victim Fund paid out more than $4.3 billion.

scene.label: paid out by the U.S. Justice Department
scene.src: U.S. DOJ via NBC New York, Dec 2024

lines.say: To more than forty thousand victims, in nearly one hundred thirty countries.
lines.show: To more than 40,000 victims, in nearly 130 countries.

scene.label: victims in nearly 130 countries
scene.src: U.S. DOJ via NBC New York, Dec 2024

lines.say: The final payout started in December twenty twenty-four. The Justice Department said eligible victims had recovered nearly ninety-four percent of their fraud losses.
lines.show: The final payout started in December 2024. The Justice Department said eligible victims had recovered nearly 94% of their fraud losses.

scene.label: of fraud losses recovered|by eligible claimants
scene.src: U.S. DOJ via NBC New York, Dec 2024

lines.say: Madoff never saw it. He died in federal custody in twenty twenty-one, at eighty-two.
lines.show: Madoff never saw it. He died in federal custody in 2021, at 82.
